requirements.statement: The four Agent System repositories are certified against immutable reviewed SHAs and TSIC itself is pinned as the integration authority.
The certified stack preserves the authority chain TADL -> Agent OS -> SDK -> Agent Platform, with Platform as the sole consequential authority.
Tenant and authenticated-principal context remains bound through the cross-repository execution path.
Consequential operations preserve idempotency and fail closed on conflicting replay.
Trace and correlation context survive the developer-to-Platform path.
Authoritative evidence remains Platform-owned and is not minted by upstream layers.
The TSIC-controlled certification workflow executes the pinned Agent System conformance suite successfully.
